title: Soul Feast #3: What is The New Consciousness?
excerpt: In today’s Soul Feast, Gary Zukav dives deeper into the origins of his inspiration for The Seat of the Soul.
bodyHtml:
In today’s Soul Feast, Gary Zukav dives deeper into the origins of his inspiration for The Seat of the Soul. 

He recounts his personal encounters with non-physical teachers like Ambrose and Genesis, revealing how these interactions opened him to a broader understanding of love, power, and wisdom. 

Through these teachings, Gary began to recognize the profound connection between the human experience and the universe, understanding that all guidance comes from this vast, universal wisdom.

Gary explores the concept of the new consciousness, a multi-sensory perception that helps us access non-physical reality and understand our deeper connection to the world. 

By embracing this awareness, we take personal responsibility for our choices, guided by love and wisdom, and align ourselves with the universe’s greater purpose.

As you listen, you’ll gain a deeper understanding of how the new consciousness is emerging in all of us, how connecting with non-physical teachers can guide us toward alignment with love and power, and how multi-sensory perception enables us to navigate life with greater wisdom. 

Gary also touches on the key moment when he first recognized Genesis’ voice within his own thoughts, further deepening his understanding of non-physical communication.

What We Discuss in This Episode:

  • (02:04) The inspiration behind The Seat of the Soul and Gary’s encounters with non-physical teachers.
  • (06:34) The nature of love, power, and wisdom through the lens of multi-sensory perception.
  • (10:54) The emergence of the new consciousness and how it shifts our understanding of reality.
  • (17:20) Personal responsibility and the power of conscious choices.
  • (20:47) How multi-sensory perception helps us navigate life with greater awareness and connection.

Are you ready to explore the new consciousness and live Beyond the Five Senses?
